prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original wide scenic establishing illustration of the Woodland Realm of Mirkwood, centered on the Elvenking's Halls, for a One Ring culture background. Match the user's approved latest light-ivory pencil establishing series: Lothlorien, Lindon, Rivendell, Dale, Shire and northern ranger lands. Camera pulled far back and elevated to a high three-quarter viewpoint, looking across an ancient densely wooded river valley. A forest river winds between massive old trees with tangled roots and fern-covered banks. An elegant but restrained timber-and-stone bridge crosses the river to an imposing carved elven gateway set into the foot of a wooded rocky hill; this gateway is the principal entrance to subterranean halls. Suggest the hidden breadth of the realm with a few smaller side entrances and stone terraces integrated into the hillside, a small riverside landing with boats and neatly stacked wooden barrels, and modest woodland structures partly concealed among trunks. The underground halls are mostly hidden rather than exposed as a cutaway. Strong tall forest trees and interlaced branches frame the scene, with a path curving through the foreground toward the bridge. The gateway uses organic tree-root and leaf-inspired arches, understated ancient elven craftsmanship, not massive dwarven geometry. Mirkwood should feel older, denser and more mysterious than the airy treetop city of Lothlorien: the defining features are deep woodland, river bridge and hillside palace entrance, not a large visible treetop metropolis or a sunny coastal city. No foreground people, portraits or prominent figures, no spiders, monsters, battle or horror; the setting is the subject. Mood: secluded, watchful, ancient and quietly beautiful. STYLE: delicate traditional graphite and extremely muted brown-gray pencil drawing on very light near-white warm ivory drawing paper, subtle grain, expressive fine contours, restrained parallel hatching and crosshatching, airy legible shading and generous clean pale paper. Suggest woodland shadow with layered light hatching and overlapping trunks, never with heavy black fills or an overall dark image. Use pale paper for river reflections and fine forest mist. Nearby trees, bridge and gateway are selectively described; distant woods become progressively lighter and simpler. Match the approved series' light paper tone, no orange, peach, yellow or tan wash. No colored paint, thick brushwork, watercolor wash, photorealism, glossy digital rendering or 3D. Wide 16:9 full-bleed landscape, intended final export 2560x1440. No writing, readable runes, letters, labels, captions, map symbols, decorative border, frame, blank bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
